title: BlueLinx Expands Distribution Partnership with Oldcastle APG
summary: Doubles RDI® Railing Locations and Adds New MoistureShield® Decking Markets BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, today announced a major expansion of its distribution partnership with Oldcastle APG, a CRH Company. This agreement doubles the BlueLinx RDI ® Railing distribution footprint from eight to sixteen locations and adds MoistureShield ® Decking to two new markets: Long Island, NY and Portland, OR. RDI ® Railing coverage now includes Seattle, WA, Spokane, WA, Portland, OR, Cincinnati, OH, Akron, OH, Pittsburgh, PA, Buffalo, NY, and Long Island, NY, bringing industry-leading railing solutions to more customers throughout the country.
